verdict.rationale: LightSprint has no documented 'agent-readiness criteria' check, but it offers adjacent capabilities. Its onboarding agent sets up the codebase, environment variables and setup script automatically, which prepares a repo for agents. A codebase reliability/security analysis panel lets users turn recommendations into tasks. The Merge Readiness score covers individual PRs, not whether the repo is agent-ready. Missing for 10: a defined agent-readiness criteria set, an automatic remediation flow for failing criteria, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
